text:
Hektoen enteric agar is a selective medium for gram-negative enteric bacteria, particularly Salmonella and Shigella, and does not support protozoan growth, so the shared note is incorrect. Given the antibiotic history and positive culture on this medium, the most likely agent is Salmonella typhi (though antibiotic-associated C. difficile would be the classic cause without this culture result).  
CONFIDENCE: 85
